# YC metrics pack (prompt 2, G13)

```bash
pnpm --filter @campuslink/api metrics:yc                                   # the last 28 days, a table
pnpm --filter @campuslink/api metrics:yc --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-06-30 # any range of UTC days
pnpm --filter @campuslink/api metrics:yc --json                            # the same, as JSON
```

The script (`apps/api/src/scripts/metrics-yc.ts`) lists colleges inside `withPlatformScope('metrics:yc', …)` (active colleges only) and computes each college's figures inside `runInTenant`, through `YcMetricsService` (`modules/insights/yc-metrics.service.ts`). That service only combines count-only methods of the owning services; it never reads a member's record itself. Every count leaves through `suppress()` (1 to 4 shows as `<5`), and a percentage or ratio is shown only when every count behind it is shown (0 or at least 5), as on Admin › Analytics. The output holds no member id, name or text (the test checks for any 24-hex id, any address and the fixture names). Each run is recorded in the platform's audit log (`metrics.yc_run`, with the range and the number of colleges).

Ranges are UTC days, inclusive. "Now" is when the script runs: activation, retention and conversion look at what happened after the range up to now (for example, a request sent in the range that led to a session the week after counts as converted).

## The ten metrics

| #   | Metric                                      | Exact definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | From (service → collection)                                                                                      |
| --- | ------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | Colleges live                               | Active college tenants (not suspended) with at least one product event in the range.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `TenantModel` (platform scope) and `InsightsService.rangeFacts` → `productevents`                                |
| 2   | Verified members by role                    | Users with `verified: true` and `status: 'active'`, counted once per role they hold (students, alumni, faculty, placement cell, college admins). A member with two roles counts in both.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `UsersService.verifiedByRole` → `users`                                                                          |
| 3   | Weekly active students                      | Per ISO week (Monday to Sunday, UTC) that overlaps the range: distinct students with at least one `MEANINGFUL_EVENTS` event that week (request sent or answered, session completed, drive registered, study question, roadmap step). "Students" uses the dashboard's rule: not faculty, placement cell, admin or alumni (detached events count as students). The table shows the mean over complete weeks; `--json` has every week with `partial` marking the current one.                                                             | `InsightsService.rangeFacts` → `productevents` (and `producteventdailies` for weeks before the retention cutoff) |
| 4   | Activation funnel                           | Invite links created in the range → members whose first `signed_up` is in the range → of those, `verified` (at any time) → those whose 7 days have passed ("matured") → of those, a meaningful action within 7 days of signing up. Activation % = activated / matured.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `InsightsService.rangeFacts` → `productevents`; `OnboardingService.invitedSince` → `invitelinks`                 |
| 5   | Week-4 retention                            | Of the members who signed up in the range and whose fourth week after their signup week has started: the share with any event in the ISO week four weeks after their signup week.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `InsightsService.rangeFacts` → `productevents`                                                                   |
| 6   | Request → session conversion, median reply  | Mentorship requests sent in the range (`request_sent`, by request id) that have a `session_completed` with the same id by now, as a share of those sent. Median reply: hours from a request being created to its acceptance or decline, for requests answered in the range (at least five replies).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `InsightsService.rangeFacts` → `productevents`; `RequestsService.replyHoursSince` → `mentorshiprequests`         |
| 7   | Drives run and registration rate            | Drives whose drive date is in the range and that started or finished (`in_progress` or `completed`). Registration rate = Σ over those drives of the eligible students who registered (not withdrawn) ÷ Σ of the students each drive was for: verified members of its branches and batches who meet its academic rules (`checkEligibility`), plus anyone the cell let in. The batches may have graduated since, so alumni of those batches count too.                                                                                   | `PlacementsService.driveFacts` → `placementdrives`, `driveregistrations`, `profiles`, `academicrecords`          |
| 8   | Verified offers per 100 final-years, change | Final-years = the batch graduating in the academic year that holds the range's end (`currentGradYear`), as on the college's list. Offers = that batch's verified job offers (internships are not placements) verified on or before the range's end (or now). Per 100 = offers ÷ final-years × 100 (offers, not students: a student with two offers counts twice, as on Admin › Analytics; `studentsPlaced` in `--json` counts students). Change = this minus the previous batch's figure at the same date one year earlier, in points. | `OffersService.jobOffersByBatch` → `offers`; `WhitelistService.countsByCohort` → `whitelists`                    |
| 9   | AI questions per active student             | Answer requests of the AI chat features (the study assistant `study_chat` and the Career Copilot `copilot`, kind `chat`) on days in the range, ÷ students with any event in the range. Embeddings, transcription, résumé, interview and practice calls are not questions and are not counted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `AiUsageService.chatQuestionsBetween` → `aiusages`; `InsightsService.rangeFacts` → `productevents`               |
| 10  | WhatsApp read rate                          | WhatsApp messages created in the range whose last status is `read`, ÷ those whose last status is `delivered` or `read`. Sent, failed and expired messages are left out of both.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `ChannelService.whatsappStatusesBetween` → `channelmessages`                                                     |

## Caveats

- **Small colleges show little.** Everything under five is `<5`, and a rate built on one is `–`. A pilot college with a handful of active students will show mostly dashes over 28 days; widen the range.
- **Retention and the median reply need a wide range.** Over the default 28 days few sign-ups have reached their fourth week, and fortnightly requests give fewer than five replies; use a quarter or a year.
- **Events past 395 days are rolled up.** Before the retention cutoff only daily counts remain (no members), so activation, retention and conversion for such a range are not available (`eventsComplete: false`) and a weekly active figure there is a lower bound: the busiest day's members for one meaningful event.
- **Product events follow consent.** Members under 18 and members without the `analytics_aggregate` consent are never recorded, and erased or withdrawn members are detached. Weekly actives, activation, retention, conversion and "active students" therefore undercount by however many members opted out; counts from records (verified members, drives, offers, AI requests, WhatsApp) do not.
- **Offers per 100 is a season in progress.** Early in a season the figure is low; the change compares with the previous batch at the same date, not with its final figure. The roster is what the college has loaded; a college that has not loaded its list shows `–`.
- **Registration rate depends on academic records.** A drive with an academic rule counts only students whose record meets it; students without a record count as not eligible.
- **AI questions are requests, not people.** A refused or uncovered question that never reached the AI is not counted; one question can be more than one request if the provider was retried.
- **WhatsApp statuses come from the provider's webhooks.** Members who turned read receipts off never report `read`, so the rate is a lower bound.
- **The demo data has a chosen shape.** On a seeded database (`pnpm seed`) the figures describe the fictional demo year, not real colleges.

## Tests

`apps/api/test/metrics-yc.test.ts`: every metric on fixtures, suppression of small counts and the rates built on them, two colleges kept apart, no ids, addresses or names in the JSON or the table, and the range arguments.
